summary: Paid monthly and yearly membership tiers use Stripe Checkout in test mode, with webhooks updating member paying status.
detailed_changes: Added membership plans (monthly/yearly) editable by staff, with optional Stripe test price ids.
Account portal can start Checkout or open the Billing Portal; webhooks mark memberships active, past due, or canceled.
Documented test-mode keys in docs/membership.md; live Stripe charges remain unauthorized.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public members; staff
Public impact: optional paid supporter checkout in test mode when keys are configured
Internal impact: fake Stripe client in CI; no live-mode authorization
